title: Smilacis Chinae Rhizoma ethyl acetate fraction alleviates IMQ-induced psoriasis by inhibiting IL-17-driven T-cell immune responses.
authors: Wang, Yingying; Wei, Feng; Guo, Yingxue; Tang, Shuiyan; Zhang, Houwen; Jin, Lu; He, Bin; Fu, Huiying; Shou, Qiyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药提取物对银屑病小鼠模型的免疫调节作用，核心为IL-17信号通路与T细胞应答，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Smilacis Chinae Rhizoma (SCR), derived from the rhizome of Smilax china L., has long been utilized in traditional Chinese medicine for the treatment of inflammatory dermatological disorders, including cutaneous abscesses. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic potential and underlying mechanisms of Smilacis Chinae Rhizoma ethyl acetate fraction (SCR-EA) in psoriasis, with a focus on its immunomodulatory effects on T-cell responses and the IL-17 signaling pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A psoriasis-like mouse model was induced via topical imiquimod (IMQ) application. Mice were treated with SCR-EA (100 or 200 mg/kg) or methotrexate (MTX, 1 mg/kg). Psoriasis severity was assessed using the Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI). Histopathological alterations, KC proliferation, and inflammatory cytokine mRNA levels (IL-6, TGF-beta1, IL-1beta, S100A9) were analyzed. T-cell subset distribution in the spleen was examined by flow cytometry. Key IL-17 pathway proteins (IL-17A, RORgammat, p-STAT3, STAT3) were assessed by Western blot. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential targets and pathways, followed by experimental validation. RESULTS: SCR-EA significantly alleviated IMQ-induced psoriatic lesions, reduced epidermal thickness, and inhibited KC hyperproliferation. It suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokine expression and corrected the IMQ-induced imbalance of Th1, Th2, and Th17 cell subsets in the spleen. Network pharmacology identified the IL-17 signaling pathway as a major target, which was validated by SCR-EA's inhibition of IL-17A, RORgammat, and STAT3 activation. Molecular docking revealed strong binding affinities between SCR-EA's primary constituents (astilbin, engeletin, resveratrol) and IL-6 and TNF-alpha. CONCLUSION: SCR-EA mitigates IMQ-induced psoriasis by modulating T-cell differentiation and inhibiting the IL-17 signaling pathway. This study provides a pharmacological foundation for the traditional use of SCR in treating inflammatory skin conditions and positions SCR-EA as a promising multi-target candidate for psoriasis therapy.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：菝葜（Smilacis Chinae Rhizoma, SCR）来源于菝葜（Smilax china L.）的根茎，长期以来在传统中医中用于治疗炎症性皮肤病，包括皮肤脓肿。研究目的：本研究旨在评估菝葜乙酸乙酯部位（SCR-EA）在银屑病中的治疗潜力及其潜在机制，重点关注其对T细胞反应和IL-17信号通路的免疫调节作用。材料与方法：通过局部涂抹咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导银屑病样小鼠模型。小鼠分别接受SCR-EA（100或200 mg/kg）或甲氨蝶呤（MTX，1 mg/kg）治疗。使用银屑病面积和严重程度指数（PASI）评估银屑病严重程度。分析组织病理学变化、KC增殖及炎症细胞因子mRNA水平（IL-6、TGF-beta1、IL-1beta、S100A9）。通过流式细胞术检查脾脏中T细胞亚群分布。通过Western blot评估IL-17通路关键蛋白（IL-17A、RORgammat、p-STAT3、STAT3）。采用网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在靶点和通路，随后进行实验验证。结果：SCR-EA显著缓解IMQ诱导的银屑病样病变，减少表皮厚度，并抑制KC过度增殖。它抑制促炎细胞因子表达，并纠正IMQ诱导的脾脏中Th1、Th2和Th17细胞亚群失衡。网络药理学鉴定IL-17信号通路为主要靶点，并通过SCR-EA对IL-17A、RORgammat和STAT3活化的抑制得到验证。分子对接显示SCR-EA的主要成分（astilbin、engeletin、resveratrol）与IL-6和TNF-alpha之间具有强结合亲和力。结论：SCR-EA通过调节T细胞分化和抑制IL-17信号通路减轻IMQ诱导的银屑病。本研究为SCR在治疗炎症性皮肤病中的传统应用提供了药理学基础，并将SCR-EA定位为银屑病治疗中一个有前景的多靶点候选药物。
